title: Find Foundation Foods by description (October 2022)
purpose: Find Foundation Foods in this FoodData Central release whose description contains a phrase (case-insensitive; SQL wildcards % and _ keep their meaning), with each food's FDC id, description, food category and publication date. An exact description match comes first, then shorter descriptions.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Phrase to look for in food descriptions; empty text lists every Foundation Food

output_columns.name: fdc_id
output_columns.description: FoodData Central id of the food
